**How to submit:** Upload your video file and your answers (a document or a clear photo) to the university e-learning platform. Due: **before lecture 12**.
You may use AI where a task says so. Check its work and say how you used it.

## Task 1 · A first cut (2 marks)

Use three short clips of a game you play (your own recording), or the
clips of **Timeline Lab**.

a) Put the clips on V1 and a title on V2, inside the safe area. Split one
clip on an action, and ripple delete one part. (1 mark)

b) Export it as `yourname-cut-v1.mp4` (H.264 in MP4) and write its length.
(1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

## Task 2 · Choose the edit (3 marks)

a) Write **a cut**, **a cross dissolve** or **a dip to black** for each
place, with a reason: a racing car passes the camera → the next car of the
same race; the evening of day 1 → the morning of day 2 in a farm game; the
final boss falls → the logo of the game. (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=3 >}}

b) A clip recorded at 30 fps is played at 50 % speed, and it stutters. Why?
Which footage do you need? (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

c) In your cut, the music covers the voice of a character. What do you do,
and by about how much? (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}
